overloads.semanticRole: Returns a new collection of all parameters actually passed to the current method/function, optionally starting from the startFrom index (useful for forwarding a variable-length parameter list to another call).

constraints: Inside a formula, returns only the parameters passed via apply()/call(), not those passed to the enclosing method/function.
Returns an empty collection if the calling method/function was not itself called by another method/function, or if no parameters were passed to it.
